invalid_envelope.why: A harness run's approval envelope is wider than its profile's, or an edit entry has no numeric bounds or allowed values (services/run_envelope.py, study harness issue 03). Nothing is granted; the user narrows it on the plan-review card.

envelope_not_grantable.why: The plan-review verdict names a plan with no envelope, a run that is over, one already running inside a granted envelope, or nothing granted to stop. Nothing changes; the assistant reads the plan again with get_task.

envelope_decision_unavailable.why: An envelope verdict arrived with a user message or could not be applied now (harness/loop.py). Nothing is granted; the user answers the plan-review card again.
